field_checks.summary: The 16 final antibacterial MIC/MBC rows match source Table 2 and Supplement Table S1 for endpoint, value, unit, species, and strain/isolate, but every activity row has target_class null despite source-identifiable bacterial targets.

No linked authoritative APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP rows are present. The 13 DBAASP Codex fallback candidate rows remain unresolved and are not promoted to source_verified or authoritative ingest, which preserves the release boundary but leaves database curation as cautionary paper-level evidence only.

Paper final and packet final common JSON files are byte-identical; packet mechanism_evidence.json is byte-identical to mechanism_ontology_record.json. Final counts are 16 activity rows, 3 toxicity rows, 13 database audits, 6 mechanism claims, and 0 review rework targets; live open packet tickets are 0.

The six mechanism claims preserve evidence boundaries: DiSC3(5) membrane depolarization is the only direct_mechanism claim, while time-kill and biofilm are phenotype_supported, RT-qPCR effects are inferred_mechanism, and in silico discovery/modeling is computational_only.

Primary XML/PDF identify the paper as PMC11672609, PMID 39766503, DOI 10.3390/antibiotics13121113, and title PA-Win2: In Silico-Based Discovery of a Novel Peptide with Dual Antibacterial and Anti-Biofilm Activity. PA-Win2 maps to the 20-residue one-letter sequence LLRGLRYLCLKILYILKLRK from transcript TBIU038647; no terminal amidation or other residue-changing modification is reported.

Final records carry source locators and same-unit direct normalization, and no final object contains both sequence and sequence_length. However, independent enumeration found fine-grained XML cell/article-id locators in final JSON that are not exact entries in locator_index.json, although their parent source surfaces are resolvable.

The strict acceptance artifact and final database/review records keep authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready false, leave fallback rows unresolved, and state the strict boundary as paper-level evidence only. I found no recursive promotion of worker/gate output into primary authority.

The live final review preserves two database cautions: absent authoritative linked rows and unresolved DBAASP machine fallback rows. A stale packet analysis field says authoritative_linked_rows_present true, conflicting with the database manifest and authoritative match report, but the final review/database artifacts preserve the correct no-authoritative-row boundary.

The staged supplement ZIP is readable and contains one PDF member; packet extraction recovered a 9-page supplement, Figures S1-S4, Tables S1-S3, table rows, text, and figure observations with zero extraction errors and no missing/unparsed material.

The source supports three normal-human-cell cytotoxicity records and the final preserves threshold values, but all toxicity records have target_class null and cell_line null while placing HaCaT, hADMSC, and HDFalpha in target_strain_or_isolate. This omits/conflates source-reviewable toxicity target fields.

blocking_findings.reason: Final activity_toxicity_evidence.json omits source-reviewable target fields: all 16 activity_records have target_class null despite bacterial targets in Table 2 and Supplement Table S1, and all 3 toxicity_records have target_class null plus cell_line null despite Figure 2 and the cell-viability methods naming HaCaT, hADMSC, and HDFalpha/HDFα human cell lines. This is a material field-level omission/conflation, so the paper cannot be publication-grade ready even though source values and units otherwise match.
required_actions: Populate a controlled target_class for every antibacterial activity row, preserving the existing species, strain/isolate, endpoint, value, unit, and locator fields.

For toxicity rows, populate target_class with the appropriate mammalian/human-cell context and put HaCaT, hADMSC, and HDFalpha/HDFα in cell_line rather than leaving cell_line null; keep target_species as Homo sapiens.

Rerun worker-2 field-integrity validation, mirror the repaired final JSON to packet final, and have worker-6 re-adjudicate the current repaired artifact rather than relying on the previous green gate.
acceptance_checks: A Python assertion over both final mirrors must report zero activity_records or toxicity_records with null/empty target_class and zero toxicity_records with null/empty cell_line.

The repaired toxicity rows must preserve the existing source-supported thresholds and locators for HaCaT, hADMSC, and HDFalpha/HDFα, and the activity row count must remain 16 unless a cited source locator justifies a row-level change.

Paper and packet final activity_toxicity_evidence.json must be byte-identical after repair, review_report.final_counts must still match live final arrays, and live packet open_rework_ticket_count must equal the final review/ticket state.

cautions.summary: The paper-level evidence is source-reviewable, but there are zero linked authoritative APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP rows; 13 DBAASP Codex fallback machine rows remain unresolved candidate evidence and must stay out of RC2/portal/authoritative ingest.

Several final fine-grained XML locators, especially table cell and article-id coordinates, are not exact entries in locator_index.json; their parent tables/sections are resolvable, but locator-index granularity should be tightened in a future repair.
